### Bug Analysis

#### Bug Scenario Description
The bug report indicates an accessibility issue with the `ExpandableTile` component in the `@carbon/react` package. The problem arises when a `StructuredList` is placed inside an `ExpandableTile`. The `ExpandableTile` is rendered as a button, but the `StructuredList` elements have roles, which is not allowed for button children. To work around this, a hidden button was added to force the interactive version of the tile. However, this leads to an issue where the `aria-expanded` attribute cannot be set to "false".

#### Bug Root Cause
The root cause of the issue is that the `ExpandableTile` component is not handling the `aria-expanded` attribute correctly when the tile is not interactive. The component should allow setting `aria-expanded` to "false" even when the tile is not interactive.

### Bug Location and Fix

#### Bug Location
The issue is located in the `ExpandableTile` component within the `Tile.tsx` file. Specifically, the handling of the `aria-expanded` attribute needs to be adjusted to ensure it can be set to "false" when the tile is not interactive.

#### Fix
To fix the issue, we need to ensure that the `aria-expanded` attribute is correctly set based on the `expanded` prop, regardless of whether the tile is interactive.

### Patches

```javascript
### packages/react/src/components/Tile/Tile.tsx
<<<<<<< SEARCH
    aria-expanded={isExpanded}
=======
    aria-expanded={expanded}
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

This patch ensures that the `aria-expanded` attribute reflects the `expanded` prop value, allowing it to be set to "false" when necessary.
